resources.string: Use your own photo as an icon on your home screen
Drag and pinch to frame your photo
Icon updated on your home screen
Your launcher does not allow adding shortcuts

Android does not let an app change its own icon, so this creates a shortcut on your home screen with your photo. To avoid having two icons, you can hide the original one from the app drawer, or put it in a folder yourself.\n\nIf you hide the original and later remove the shortcut, come back here to show it again. If you cannot open the app, use system Settings, Apps, Beyond Player, Open.
Hide the original icon from the app drawer
Add your shortcut first, then you can hide the original icon.
